new_results.statement: For an exact-rank-three Schur-isotropic packet with spectral scale s, residual leverage <=1/2, and an original-coordinate exact two-plane bank Omega>=omega>0, ||p_Q||inf <= (12/s)(1+1/(2omega))^(1/3) uniformly in shear r>0.
The prior Walsh-Hadamard mixed-source family with spectrum {-1,1,1} satisfies ||p_Q||inf <=12*3^(1/3) uniformly for m>=8 and every r>0, including the two-sheet side.

A circular Parseval frame gives exact target spectrum {-1,1,1}, enters every fixed N3 window, has leverage 3/m, yet every exact two-plane bank has Omega<=4/m^2. This refutes exact-planar-bank extraction as a general N3 mechanism, not QFORM itself.

unresolved_implication.statement: In the Schur-isotropic N3 survivor with no dimension-free exact two-plane bank, spend the aggregate transverse Pluecker identity sum_{i<j}det(n,v_i,v_j)^2=1 before conditioning destroys product provenance, to control the whole two-sheet line for a genuinely three-dimensional residual bank. The circular frame is the stress test.
